contract.structure: 64 fungible resources, iid marked Poisson arrivals, need32/64, independent class-exponential hidden service, strict nonpreemptive FCFS, no locality, no size lookahead, no overhead
contract.label: Known two-class theorem; X = 1 / ((1-p)/mu_big + p*(2-p)/(2*mu_small)); lambda=z X; equality excluded
contract.observations: Diagnostic receives only arrivals/need up to A_H and completion id/time <= A_H; reconstruct FCFS starts with unobserved ends as infinity. Exposure integrates class running counts; queued jobs add zero exposure. No true S, estimates, future departures or population parameters in LEARNED_CS API.
contract.inference: Gamma(1,rate=1) mixture E(theta)=exp(theta V) Gamma(M+1) / ((V+1)^(M+1) theta^M), and Beta(1,1) mark mixture. Confidence set E < 1/delta. Fixed normalized time units; numeric log slack=1e-6 plus outward roots. Existing likelihood-mixture/Ville methods, not novel theory.
contract.proof: For class j, completion intensity=mu_j R_j(t), predictable at-risk running count, with V_j=integral R_j. Likelihood ratio against r is (r/mu)^M exp(-(r-mu)V). Mixing preserves nonnegative martingale/supermartingale property. Ville per process and four-way union bound give joint .05 anytime coverage under the model; independence among four processes is not required. This is a model-conditioned derivation, not real-world guarantee or new published theorem.
contract.capacity_enclosure: Use rational arithmetic on interval endpoint floats. X increases in both service rates. 1/X is concave in p; evaluate endpoints and p*=1-mu_small/mu_big when inside for lower X. Upper X at p endpoints. Outward float conversion. Unbounded parameters => conservative UNKNOWN.
methods: PAST_AB: restored sample-variance WSC2003 AB, past arrivals/departures only, nominal alpha .05 not guaranteed error rate
KNOWN_CS: known true population capacity and arrival CS with error .05
ALLOCATED_CS: known true population capacity and same arrival CS .0125 as learned; isolates error allocation
LEARNED_CS: four CS (lambda,p,mu_small,mu_big), .0125 each, infer all population parameters from past-only observations; capacity rectangle
PLUGIN_MLE: same past observations, plug-in population estimates M/V,p=n_small/H, compare H/T to X point, binary no error guarantee
contract.sampling: 50 seeds each model/load, all horizons are nested prefixes generated once at320k. Same seeds across loads induce cross-cell dependence; rates use seed repetitions within cell. 400 workloads,1200seed-look rows,6000decisions.
contract.rates: Per-cell wrong/UNKNOWN CP intervals: family .05 over240 rates. Anylook wrong/alllooks unresolved CP: .05 over80 rates. Count a seed once if any of its looks is wrong. Joint parameter coverage audited outside inference API.
contract.stop_rule: Full fixed grid: wrong/UNKNOWN and prediction failures are measured outcomes. First seal/source mismatch, invalid/nonfinite observation, native start/exposure alignment failure, enclosure/nesting identity failure => R3 and stop. No expansion or tuning.
contract.fixtures: HOL past exposure and future-input rejection,20 exact-CTMC parameter cases,interior capacity extremum; native H1000 each model seeds8801/8802 atz1.2,departure/start error<1e-7,exposure error<1e-6; fixtures are not grid seeds or independent replication

predictions.S4: PLUGIN_MLE wrong>=5/50 at one or more z.99/1.01,H20k cells

contract.seal_integrity: Local byte hashes and clock only, no external timestamp. Analytic specialization and mechanism checks known before seal. No seed9101-9150 observed in prior C042 protocols. Unknown-parameter assumption refers to inference inputs, not blinded experiment author.
contract.claim_boundary: Bounded two-class synthetic exponential FCFS and sufficient past telemetry only. General U31/c12, actual GPU effects, novelty, external independent replication and peer review remain UNKNOWN; validated general detector=0.

public_projection: Curated JSON, not byte-identical sealed protocol or original result. Seal hashes refer to original local artifacts. Native fixtures are recorded; public runner regenerates the causal FCFS oracle without private native engine.
